description: ผมมีสกิลในด้าน coding ที่ดีครับ และเราต้องการคนที่มีความรู้ความสามารถเกี่ยวกับ NASA เพิ่มเติมเพื่อมาเติมเต็มให้กับทีมของเรา
summary: MARSWALK is an interactive Mars surface navigator for the first human explorers. Pick a landing site on a 3D globe, then plan a safe EVA route over layered topography, thermal, radiation and slope data, with suit consumable limits and a helmet-view preview of the route.
details: Users start on a draggable, zoomable Mars globe with real coordinates for landing sites such as Gale Crater, Jezero Crater and Olympus Mons. Selecting a site opens a local EVA planner built on a Gale-type crater analog. It layers optical, topographic, thermal, radiation and traversability data, models sun angle and shadows by local time, adds a solar particle event slider, and uses A* pathfinding to avoid slopes above the suited-walking limit. The app reports distance, walk time, EVA dose and consumables against an 8-hour PLSS limit, and shows a first-person helmet view along the route. Built with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Canvas 2D and Web Audio. Terrain is procedurally generated (simulated); the design allows real MOLA/HiRISE terrain to be swapped in.
